title: Senior App Developer / Technical Auditor for Premier Massage Apps & Websites (Short-Term Project)
description:
Senior App Developer / Technical Auditor for Premier Massage Apps & Websites (Short-Term Project)



Premier Massage is seeking an experienced App Developer or Technical Consultant to conduct an independent audit of our existing apps and websites.



This is a short-term project focused on evaluating our digital assets and ensuring that Premier Massage has complete ownership, access, and control of all source code, hosting accounts, databases, domains, third-party integrations, and related resources associated with our apps and websites.



The goal of this project is to be completed within 3 days of the selected candidate being granted access to the necessary systems and information. Please only apply if you are available to dedicate the time needed to complete a thorough audit and deliver the required findings within this timeframe.



Project Objectives

* Review Premier Massage apps and websites

* Verify ownership and access to all source code repositories

* Confirm company access to hosting accounts, databases, domains, APIs, and third-party services

* Identify any gaps in ownership, permissions, documentation, or security

* Evaluate the quality, organization, and maintainability of the codebase

* Assess the overall technical health of the apps and websites

* Identify potential risks, dependencies, or concerns

* Provide a written report with findings and recommendations



Requirements

* 5+ years of professional software development experience

* Strong experience with web and/or mobile applications

* Experience working with source control platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket

* Experience auditing existing applications and websites

* Ability to quickly evaluate unfamiliar codebases and technical environments

* Proactive mindset with the ability to identify issues, risks, and opportunities without constant direction

* Strong leadership skills and ability to provide clear technical recommendations and guidance

* Excellent documentation and communication skills

* High attention to detail, professionalism, and accountability



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience as a Senior Developer, Technical Lead, Software Architect, or CTO

* Experience performing technical due diligence, code reviews, or ownership audits

* Experience taking over, maintaining, or evaluating existing software projects



Deliverables

At the end of the project, we expect:

* A comprehensive audit report summarizing the current state of all Premier Massage apps, websites, databases, hosting accounts, domains, and related technical assets

* An executive summary that clearly explains findings, risks, and recommendations in terms that can be easily understood by non-technical stakeholders

* Verification of ownership, access, and administrative control of all technical assets, including identification of any gaps or dependencies on third parties

* Documentation of any risks, concerns, vulnerabilities, missing credentials, missing documentation, or potential business continuity issues

* A detailed inventory of all technical assets, including where they are hosted, who has access, and how they are managed

* Clear recommendations for protecting, maintaining, and securing Premier Massage's digital assets, with explanations of why each recommendation matters and its potential business impact

* Recommendations for future development, improvements, scalability, and long-term technical management

* A final review meeting with Premier Massage leadership to present findings, answer questions, and explain technical concepts, recommendations, and action items in a manner that is easy for a non-technical person to understand and follow



TO APPLY

Please include in your application message:

1. A brief summary of your experience

2. The technologies and platforms you specialize in

3. Examples of similar audits, code reviews, or technical assessments you have completed

4. Have you ever audited an app or website to verify ownership, source code access, hosting access, and other technical assets? If so, please briefly describe the project and your findings.

5. Your availability over the next 2-3 weeks

6. We have researched the estimated market rate for this project, but we would like to know your proposed rate based on your experience, qualifications, and approach to the audit.



We are looking for someone who can provide an objective assessment and help ensure that Premier Massage has full control, ownership, and protection of its apps, websites, and related technical assets.



Potential Long-Term Opportunity

While this is initially a short-term audit project, the selected candidate may have the opportunity to work with Premier Massage on a long-term, project-based basis for the ongoing maintenance, updates, improvements, and development of our apps and websites.



At Premier Massage, we highly value loyalty, honesty, integrity, and quality workmanship. We believe in building long-term partnerships with people we can trust and rely on. If the project is a good fit for both parties, there may be opportunities for continued collaboration on future technical projects.



We are looking for someone who can provide an objective assessment now and potentially become a trusted technical resource for Premier Massage in the future.



To make sure you’ve read and followed the instructions, please answer this question at the end of your application: "What is your favorite day of the year, and why?"

title: Remote Virtual RCM Assistant – Dental Practice
description:
We are seeking a Remote Virtual Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Assistant to join our team and help optimize the financial processes of our dental practice. As a key member of our team, you’ll ensure timely payments, minimize claim denials, and streamline billing and insurance processes.



Key Responsibilities:



Insurance Verification: Verify patient insurance details, eligibility, and benefits before treatment to ensure accurate coverage and reduce claim denials.

Coding & Billing: Accurately apply CPT and ICD codes, prepare, submit, and follow up on dental insurance claims.

Claims Management: Monitor claim status, follow up on unpaid claims, and appeal denials with the necessary documentation.

Patient Billing & Collections: Generate invoices, manage co-pays and out-of-pocket expenses, set up payment plans, and communicate with patients regarding balances.

Account Reconciliation: Reconcile patient accounts, track and resolve discrepancies in accounts receivable.

Compliance: Ensure billing and coding practices comply with HIPAA and other healthcare regulations. Stay updated on insurance policies and changes in codes.

Reporting & Analysis: Generate financial reports to monitor revenue, collections, and expenses, analyzing data for improvement opportunities.

Skills & Qualifications:



Knowledge of dental insurance policies and reimbursement processes.

Proficiency with dental billing software (Carestack experience a plus).

Strong communication skills for interaction with patients and insurance providers.

Attention to detail to minimize errors in billing, coding, and claims.

Excellent organizational skills to manage multiple accounts and claims efficiently.

This is a remote, virtual position offering flexible work hours and the opportunity to contribute to the success of a growing dental practice.



If you're ready to make a difference in a dynamic dental environment, apply today!

description:

## What you will do

- Build the design slides on-brand (we provide brand guidelines), with editable text layers.

- Write a clear step-by-step SOP and record a short Loom, so the workflow can be repeated on our other collections.



## The most important skill (pass or fail)

The product in every AI image must look EXACTLY like the real photos: same seam, same waistband, same color, no fake logo. If the product changes, the image is rejected, no matter how nice it looks.



## Skills we need

- Experience with Freepik Magnific or a similar node-based AI image tool.

- Keeping a real product unchanged across AI-generated scenes (references, inpainting, and similar).

- Graphic design: clean, on-brand layout and typography (Figma or Photoshop).

- Light photo retouching.

- Able to write a clear, simple SOP.

- Reliable, detail-focused, and follows instructions exactly.

- Bonus: short-form video, Shopify, multilingual design.



## We provide

A Freepik Magnific login, all product photos, the model face, the brand guidelines, and Gemini access.



## REQUIRED test (do this before you apply)

From this product photo, create a gym lifestyle image: the same product worn by a model in a gym, with the product looking exactly the same as in the photo.



Photo: 



Attach your result to your application. Applications without the test image will be ignored.



## To apply

- Start your message with the word LUNA-GYM so we know you read this post.

- Attach your gym lifestyle test image.

- Send your portfolio (include any real product placed into an AI scene, product unchanged).

- Tell us your Freepik Magnific / AI experience and your availability.



## Pay

200 USD for the Luna build: 100 USD for the carousel images and 100 USD for the SOP. This is the first of seven collections, with ongoing paid per-collection work for the right person.



Apply:

Create a squat image in the gym of this picture, fully branded and correct product details (no picture = no job guaranteed)

title: Estimating Manager
description:
Job Summary 

The Estimating Manager is responsible for building a reliable, scalable estimating function that helps the company respond quickly to opportunities while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and strong bid quality. 



This role is not just responsible for producing takeoffs. It owns the estimating process from bid intake through preconstruction coordination, including resource planning, quote collection, bid tracking, quality review, and process improvement. The role should strengthen the company’s ability to handle more opportunities without sacrificing accuracy or overloading operating teams. 

 

The right person will combine electrical estimating judgment, strong process discipline, and practical use of software and AI tools to improve speed, visibility, and output quality. 





Key Responsibilities 

1. Estimating Operations 

- Lead the day-to-day estimating workflow, including bid intake, takeoff coordination, estimate development, and bid-status tracking. 

- Ensure bid packages and specifications are reviewed quickly and routed to the right internal or external estimating resources. 

-Maintain visibility on active bids, priorities, deadlines, and handoffs. 



2. Quality, Accuracy, and Preconstruction Support 

- Review estimates and takeoffs for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with scope before submission. 

- Coordinate RFIs, clarifications, subcontractor pricing, and material quotes needed to support sound bid submission. 

- Support post-award preconstruction documentation, including submittals and related handoff materials, where needed. 



3. System Building and Capacity Growth 

- Build and improve the estimating system, including playbooks, templates, workflows, and use of outside estimating support when appropriate. 

- Increase estimating throughput in a controlled way by improving process, resource coordination, and tool usage. 

- Identify practical opportunities to use software and AI tools to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and strengthen estimating output. 



Required Qualifications 

- 3 to 5+ years of construction estimating experience, with meaningful experience in electrical estimating or electrical takeoffs. 

- Strong ability to read construction drawings, specifications, and electrical plans and translate them into organized, accurate takeoffs and pricing support. 

- Demonstrated experience using at least one major digital takeoff or estimating platform effectively; ability to learn additional tools quickly. 

- Strong working proficiency in Excel and document management in a deadline-driven environment. 

- Experience coordinating quotes, bid information, and estimating deliverables across multiple projects at the same time. 

- Clear written and verbal English communication suitable for working with US-based leadership, vendors, and supply houses. 

- Self-directed and dependable in a remote work environment with time-sensitive deliverables. 

- Practical working knowledge of AI tools for business use, including using them to improve speed, organization, drafting, research support, or workflow quality. 

- Strong English proficiency 



Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience working for a US-based electrical contractor, general contractor, or construction services firm. 

- Experience helping build or improve estimating processes, templates, or SOPs. 

- Familiarity with Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or similar takeoff and markup tools. 

- Experience working with outsourced estimating support or specialized consultants. 

- Degree or formal training in construction, engineering, or a related field. 



Core Values 

Success in this role requires alignment with the company’s core values: 



Trust Is Our Foundation 

- Communicate clearly and consistently on bid status, risks, and deadlines 

- Follow through on commitments and maintain reliability under time pressure 

 

Teamwork Is Our Edge 

- Coordinate effectively with operations, leadership, vendors, and external estimating support 

- Share information proactively to keep projects and bids moving forward 

 

Our Work Is Our Proof 

- Deliver accurate, well-organized, and professional estimating output 

- Take ownership of quality and continuously improve the standard of work 

 



Always Learning, Always Teaching 

- Continuously improve estimating methods, tools, and workflows 

- Share knowledge, templates, and improvements to strengthen the broader team

title: Behavioral Health Billing Specialist

The ideal candidate will have experience working with Medicaid, Managed Care Organizations (MCOs), Fee-for-Service (FFS) funding, private insurance billing, and behavioral health electronic medical records such as KIPU. Insurance Verification & Eligibility

Verify insurance eligibility and benefits through EMEVS and other payer portals.

Run EMEVS eligibility checks for potential outpatient admissions and communicate funding information to admissions staff.

Complete eligibility verification for newly admitted outpatient clients and update insurance information within KIPU as needed.

Conduct monthly eligibility reviews for all active outpatient clients and notify appropriate staff of funding changes.

Billing & Claims Management

Bill Medicaid, Fee-for-Service (FFS), and other applicable outpatient claims accurately and timely.

Assist with back billing and claim correction projects as needed.

Update outpatient billing spreadsheets on a weekly basis using attendance records and service documentation.

Post Medicaid remittance payments and maintain accurate reimbursement tracking spreadsheets.

Maintain organized billing records and documentation for audits and compliance purposes.

Payment Reconciliation

Reconcile Medicaid, FFS, and other payer payments.

Review remittance advice and resolve payment discrepancies.

Track outstanding claims and follow up on denied or unpaid claims.

Additional Responsibilities

Process and track state Uber transportation reimbursement requests.

Provide billing support and coverage for Detox and Residential billing operations when needed.

Assist with special billing projects and departmental initiatives.

Collaborate with admissions, clinical, and finance teams to ensure accurate and timely billing processes.

Qualifications

Required

Minimum 2 years of healthcare or behavioral health billing experience.

Knowledge of Medicaid, Managed Care Organizations (MCOs), Fee-for-Service (FFS), and private insurance billing.

Experience with insurance eligibility verification and authorization management.

Strong Microsoft Excel and spreadsheet management skills.

Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred

Experience with KIPU EMR.

Experience with behavioral health, substance abuse, or mental health treatment programs.

Knowledge of EMEVS eligibility verification systems.

Experience with claim reconciliation, remittance posting, and denial management.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

High level of confidentiality and professionalism.

Full-Time

Standard business hours

nts

Traveler memories

Local culture

Architecture

Food experiences

Behind-the-scenes 
nts

Fun travel memories

REQUIRED SKILLS

BONUS SKILLS

munities

Put "Photo Crown" in your subject line.

Submit your resume.

Submit a portfolio with MULTIPLE examples of your work.

Applicants who do NOT provide a portfolio with multiple examples of their work will NOT be considered.

•        Carry out any other reasonable assignment that may assist in the smooth operation of the business.



 



Requirements





Minimum Required Skills and Knowledge



•        At least three years of business development experience within the travel industry in the South East ASIA, ideally with a focus on the polar travel industry.

•        Familiarity with travel marketing channels and initiatives.

•        Discipline, self-motivation, and proven experience working independently within set guidelines.



•        Proficiency with
, word processing, and spreadsheet applications.

title: Pet Ecommerce - Operations & Marketing Assistant - Hepper / Pangolia
description:
Pet Ecommerce - Operations & Marketing Assistant - Hepper / Pangolia



Hi there!



We're hiring an Operations & Marketing Assistant to support the eCommerce and logistics side of Hepper, our modern cat product brand - with the opportunity to assist across other Pangolia businesses too (e.g. PangoVet).



In this role, you'll be responsible for keeping our product listings accurate, our inventory tracked, and our day-to-day operations running smoothly. Your domain is the behind-the-scenes work that makes everything else possible - and we need someone who takes pride in getting the details right!



About Us:



Pangolia is a fully remote, international company. We run high-traffic content, media, and eCommerce platforms that reach millions of pet owners each month — including 
, 
, 
, and 
.



Hepper designs modern, beautiful products for cats and cat lovers. You'll be supporting the operations that get those products into customers' hands.



About the Role:



You'll be supporting listing management, inventory coordination, reporting, customer communication and marketplace expansion across Amazon, WooCommerce, and beyond. Much of your work will follow clear processes — but not everything will.



This role requires someone who can balance accuracy, initiative, and communication. You should feel confident taking action within guidelines, but equally comfortable pausing to clarify when something doesn't fit the usual process, and eventually, creating your own. 



This is not a passive, task-only role. We're looking for someone proactive, reliable, and communicative.



What You'll Be Doing:



1. Managing and updating product listings on Amazon and WooCommerce

2. Tracking stock levels and coordinating restocks across platforms

3. Assisting with basic financial and sales reporting using spreadsheets

4. Organising SKUs, listings, product documentation, and data

5. Supporting expansion into new platforms like Walmart, Chewy, and wholesale channels

6. Monitoring customer reviews and competitor activity on marketplaces

7. Produce research reports on products, competitors and our partners

8. Assist in marketing campaigns across 
 and 

9. Supporting operational tasks across other Pangolia businesses as needed



What Success Looks Like:



1. Listings are accurate, up to date, and consistent across platforms

2. Inventory is tracked reliably with no surprise stockouts

3. Reports are delivered on time and error-free

4. Product data and documentation are well organised and easy to find

5. You flag issues and ask questions at the right time (not too late, not unnecessarily early)

6. Customers are responded to professionally and in a timely manner

7. (Eventually) your marketing and partnership efforts are able to drive growth for 
 (and perhaps even other Pangolia businesses). 



Musts for the Role:



1. 1–4 years of experience in eCommerce, operations, or digital marketing

2. Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or WooCommerce

3. Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel)

4. High attention to detail and ability to work independently

5. Strong written and verbal English communication

6. Reliable internet connection and remote work setup

7. In the first line of your application, please tell us the name of the last product you bought online — we're curious people!



Bonus (Nice to Have):



1. Experience with other marketplaces like Walmart or Chewy

2. Familiarity with wholesale or B2B sales channels

3. Experience with inventory or order management tools

4. Comfort with Adobe Suite (.ai, .psd etc.) 

5. Comforting with AI platforms and solutions

6. Understanding of basic financial accounting/reporting



What You Can Expect From Us:



1. Support to set you up for success

2. Autonomy and trust once you're up to speed

3. A collaborative relationship with a small, passionate, global team

4. A role that will evolve and grow as the business does



Perks:



1. Flexible work hours

2. 10 PTO days annually

3. 13th-month bonus paid in December

4. Public holidays off

5. Internet reimbursement

title: Lead Generation Specialist for Video Production Company
description:
Coastal Cineworks is looking for a full-time Lead Generation Specialist to help grow our video production company by identifying qualified leads, verifying contact information, and conducting consistent outreach to potential clients. This role will be responsible for researching businesses, agencies, marketing teams, hospitality brands, and organizations located primarily in Charleston, South Carolina, the Lowcountry region, and throughout the Southeastern United States that could benefit from professional video production services. Responsibilities include building targeted prospect lists, finding and verifying decision-maker contact information, managing outreach through
 and CRM platforms, and helping generate qualified sales opportunities for our team. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and experienced in lead generation, prospecting, and outbound sales support. Experience working with creative agencies, marketing services, or video production companies is a plus but not required.



The position is full-time (40 hours per week) with a target of generating 25-50 high-quality, qualified leads per week. The successful candidate will use tools such as Google Workspace, HubSpot or a similar CRM,
 verification platforms, and lead research tools to maintain accurate prospect data and outreach tracking. Weekly reporting will be required, including the number of leads generated, outreach activities completed, responses received, meetings booked, and recommendations for improving results. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the process, work independently, and help create a predictable pipeline of sales opportunities for our growing production company.



In addition to a competitive monthly salary, Coastal Cineworks offers performance-based incentives. Qualified candidates will have the opportunity to earn commission and percentage-based bonuses on projects that result directly from their lead generation efforts. We want this role to be a true partnership, rewarding tea
mbers who consistently help bring new business through the door. The more successful you are in helping generate booked productions, the greater your earning potential.



To apply, please include a brief introduction outlining your lead generation experience, examples of past results, any relevant CRM or prospecting tools you have used, and why you believe you would be a good fit for this position. We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who can grow with the company and become an important part of our business development efforts.



To view our work, please visit our website:

We're a fast-growing US-based jewelry and accessory business making our first dedicated finance hire. title: Bookkeeper / Jr Accountant
description:
Bookkeeper/ Junior Accountant at Insight Matters

 

About the role:



We are looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper – Junior Accountant to support a select number of client accounts. This is a hands-on role focused on accurate, timely, and high-quality bookkeeping. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment and experienced with cloud-based accounting tools.

 

Who you’ll be working with:

 

We are Insight Matters.

 

We provide our clients with financial insights that they use to grow faster, better, and healthier businesses. Based on our input, they make life changing decisions about hiring, investing, and improving their strategic plans.



Our clients use our services to answer critical business questions like, “Can they invest in hiring a new person? Are they getting the right return on marketing? Where are they leaving money on the table? Which products or services are most profitable?”



We are a full-service financial support service, working mainly with e-Commerce and Service companies - delivering the full finance function, from accounting to fractional CFO services, and from management reporting and analysis to internal control.



Our team is entirely remote and is currently dispersed among several nations in Europe, Asia, and South America, while the majority of our clients are located in the US, Europe, and Asia. We are a team of  25 and are growing rapidly.



Our #1 priority is delivering quality to our clients – we are their trusted partner for big decisions, so quality is non-negotiable.

Our team culture is open, informal, equal, based on trust and transparency, and heavily emphasises asking questions and learning from each other and our mistakes.

 

What you’ll be doing



You will manage bookkeeping activities for assigned clients, ensuring weekly and monthly deliverables are accurate, complete, and delivered on time.

 

Core Bookkeeping Responsibilities:

Perform daily, weekly and monthly accounting tasks, including bank reconciliations, transaction categorization, and maintaining clean, audit-ready books.

Support other tea
mbers in recording and reconciling revenue, expenses, and other transactions in line with accounting policies.

Maintain supporting schedules and documentation for all transactions.

Resolve open items and discrepancies, coordinating with clients as needed.

Access and work with relevant banking and payment platforms to verify transactions and gather supporting documents.

Support month-end closing procedures.



Client Coordination & Issue Resolution:

Identify and resolve inconsistencies, missing information, or other open items with clients.

Maintain clear documentation of reconciliations and accounting adjustments.

Ensure timely resolution of accounting issues to support accurate month-end closing.



 To succeed in this role, you most likely have:

2+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience, including end-to-end processes and month-end close.

Hands-on experience with cloud-based accounting platforms (e.g., QBO, Xero, NetSuite).

Experience working remotely and independently.

Strong business acumen, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Experience with multi-currency or international clients is a plus.



Personal Traits:

Highly organized and structured, with a strong eye for detail.

Proactive in asking questions and resolving issues.

Eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Comfortable receiving constructive feedback as a learning opportunity.

Flexible working hours aligned with CET time zone.



What’s in It for You:

Key role in a dynamic team shaping the future of our clients.

Exposure to a variety of clients and industries.

Open, supportive, and positive team culture.

Environment where initiative is appreciated and rewarded.

 

Benefits:

Competitive gross salary: USD 600–800 per month based on 40-hour workweek 

25 days paid holiday per year

Monthly contribution to home office costs

Training budget and time

Flexible working hours aligned with the CET time zone



Link for the form: 



Application process

Filling out the application form:

You’ll get a request to send us a video of up to 3 minutes (but not longer) to briefly introduce yourself and tell us a little about you and why you think you’re the right person for our role

Initial brief interview

Test project - A chance to see if our working styles match

In depth Skills interview – We’ll focus on the skills and experience you bring to the table

In depth Culture-fit interview – We’ll focus on your style, our style, and our company culture. This fit is crucial to making our working relationship a win-win



*Please note that this is a gross salary and that you are responsible for any tax-related procedures in your country of residence. We kindly ask you to apply only if you are happy to work remotely as an independent contractor.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Health & Wellness Content Editor / Social Media Creator
description:
About Nosu



Nosu is a Dutch health-and-wellness brand focused on helping people reshape their relationship with sweetness, cravings, food habits, and metabolic health.



Our brand is built around the idea that long-term wellness does not come from extreme restriction or quick fixes, but from small, sustainable changes in behavior. We create content around topics such as sugar cravings, blood sugar, insulin resistance, glucose metabolism, appetite, food noise, weight management, sweet taste, reward, and healthier daily habits.



Nosu’s brand direction is modern, reliable, approachable, innovative, and grounded. Our visual identity combines vibrant organic visuals, clean photography, modern typography, and relatable human lifestyle imagery, so the brand feels both scientific and accessible.



Role Overview



Health & Wellness Content Editor / Social Media Creator



We are looking for a strong content editor and social media creator to help us turn simplified health and metabolic-health topics into blog articles and Instagram content.



This role is ideal for someone who is good at writing, editing, simplifying information, creating educational social posts, and working with health/wellness content.



You do not need to be a doctor, scientist, or medical researcher. However, you should be comfortable working with topics like nutrition, blood sugar, cravings, metabolic health, supplements, appetite, and behavior change.



You should be able to make content feel simple, relatable, and engaging without making exaggerated claims.



Main Responsibilities



1. Turn one topic into blog articles



For every assigned topic or subtopic, you will create a short or medium-length blog article.



The article should:



* Be easy to understand.

* Speak directly to our target persona.

* Use simple, natural language.

* Avoid overly technical explanations.

* Avoid exaggerated health or medical claims.

* Explain why the topic matters in everyday life.

* Connect the topic to cravings, food behavior, metabolic health, or healthy habits.

* Always include a natural tie-in to Nosu.



The blog article should not feel like a generic SEO article. It should feel like it was written for someone who struggles with cravings, sugar, food noise, dieting, energy dips, or feeling out of control around sweet foods.



The goal is to make the reader think:



“This explains what I experience. This brand understands me.”



2. Repurpose each topic into Instagram content



After creating the blog article, you will turn the same topic into Instagram content.



This may include:



* Educational carousel posts

* Single-image educational posts

* Myth-vs-fact posts

* Quote posts

* Problem/solution posts

* Founder/expert-style educational posts

* Relatable meme-style posts

* UGC/testimonial-inspired posts

* Product education posts

* Ingredient education posts

* Simple visual explainers

* Story slides

* Reel script ideas



Each Instagram post should focus on one topic or subtopic only.



For example:



* One post about insulin resistance

* One post about why sugar cravings happen

* One post about food noise

* One post about blood sugar spikes

* One post about how sweet taste connects to reward

* One post about how Nosu fits into a healthy routine



The posts should follow the formats used by strong DTC health and supplement brands: educational, relatable, visual, simple, and built for social media attention.



3. Write Instagram captions



For each Instagram post, you will write a caption that:



* Hooks the reader.

* Explains the idea clearly.

* Feels natural and human.

* Speaks in the language of our target audience.

* Reinforces the blog topic.

* Includes a natural tie-in to Nosu.

* Encourages saves, shares, comments, or clicks when relevant.



Captions should not feel overly salesy. They should feel educational and helpful, while still moving the reader closer to understanding why Nosu exists.



4. Collaborate on visuals



Visuals will be a collaboration.



Nosu can provide:



* Product photography

* Lifestyle images

* Brand assets

* Visual references

* Design examples

* Templates

* Creative direction



The hire can help with:



* Choosing the best visual format

* Creating simple graphics

* Building carousels in Canva, Figma, or similar tools

* Suggesting image concepts

* Adding text overlays

* Making sure posts look clean and on-brand



The added text and layout should reflect Nosu’s visual identity: clean, modern, approachable, science-backed, and visually consistent.



We want the content to feel like a real brand system, not random social posts.



5. Apply Nosu’s brand tone



All content should feel aligned with Nosu’s brand.



We want to make complex health topics understandable, but we do not want to overpromise or make medical claims.



6. Support our organic strategy



The hire should help us build an organic content system based on the strongest DTC health brands.



This includes helping us create a healthy mix of:



* Educational posts

* Category education

* Product education

* Relatable posts

* Social proof posts

* Founder/expert-style posts

* Lifestyle and habit content

* Myth-busting content

* Simple explainers

* Community/persona-led content



Over time, this content should help Nosu become a trusted educational brand in the space of sugar cravings, metabolic health, food behavior, and healthier habits.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a good fit if you:



* Have excellent English writing and editing skills.

* Can turn simple notes into strong, polished content.

* Can write in a way that speaks to a specific target audience.

* Understand how to make health content relatable.

* Have experience with wellness, nutrition, supplements, fitness, psychology, or behavior-change content.

* Can create Instagram carousels or social media posts.

* Have a good eye for clean design and visual hierarchy.

* Can use Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, or similar tools.

* Can follow brand guidelines and content structures.

* Are detail-oriented.

* Understand that health content must be careful, accurate, and not exaggerated.

* Can collaborate with a brand team on visuals and messaging.

* Can turn one topic into multiple useful content assets.



Important: What This Role Is Not



Nosu will provide the source material, simplified explanation, key takeaways, and strategic direction.



Your main job is to turn our input into:



* A clear blog article

* Strong social posts

* Great caption

* Clean, brand-aligned visual content



This is also not purely a graphic design role. Writing, editing, and simplifying information are just as important as creating the final Instagram post.



To Apply



Please send:



1. Examples of blog articles, educational content, or health/wellness writing you have created.

2. Examples of Instagram carousels, social posts, or social media graphics.

3. A short explanation of your experience with health, wellness, nutrition, supplements, fitness, or educational content.

4. A short explanation of how you would turn one topic into a blog article and Instagram post.

5. Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate.

6. Your weekly availability.

7. The tools you use for writing and design, such as Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Notion, Adobe Express, etc.

8. To confirm you’ve read this in full, please include a brief note about one of Nosu’s core values, such as behavioral change or transparency, and why it resonates with you.



Bonus points if you have experience with health brands, supplement brands, nutrition education, DTC brands, or turning complex topics into simple consumer-friendly content.

title: Performance Video Editor for Winning Meta Ads
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled Performance Video Editor to help us iterate on winning Meta video ads.



This is not a role focused on creating brand films or editing generic social content. Your main job is to take proven winning ad concepts and turn them into high-quality variations that improve engagement, retention, clarity, and freshness, without damaging what made the ad work in the first place.



You will work with existing winning creatives that we hand to you. We will usually provide the strategic direction, testing hypothesis, new hooks when relevant, and structured feedback. We are looking for someone who can execute at a high level, collaborate well, and bring strong performance-editing instincts to the table.



What you’ll do

- Create variations of existing winning Meta video ads

- Improve pacing, tighten edits, and shorten videos where needed

- Add VFX, sound effects, motion emphasis, and visual polish to key moments

- Add and refine subtitles, captions, text overlays, and on-screen hierarchy

- Integrate B-roll and additional voice-over when provided

- Clean up audio and improve overall sound quality

- Clean up cuts and make edits feel sharper and more intentional

- Deliver polished, finished 9:16 exports optimized for Meta paid social

- Revise quickly and accurately based on structured feedback

- Occasionally suggest smart edit improvements beyond the brief, with reasoning



What this role is focused on

This role is about iterating on winners, not reinventing them.



We want someone who understands how to:

- preserve the winning core of an ad

- create controlled variations tied to a specific testing hypothesis

- improve engagement in different ways through editing

- make key moments land harder without overediting

- balance direct-response performance with high production quality



What we’ll provide

- The winning concept to iterate on

- A clear brief and testing hypothesis for each variation

- New hooks when needed

- Ideas for moments to emphasize

- Additional VO, B-roll direction, or text direction when relevant

- Structured feedback for revisions

- Our Brand Book with brand direction



What we need from you

- Strong experience editing performance creative / direct-response ads

- Strong understanding of Meta paid social

- Excellent pacing and retention instincts

- Advanced editing skills beyond basic raw UGC cutting

- Strong subtitle and text-overlay design sense

- Strong VFX / SFX / motion enhancement instincts

- Clean audio editing and finishing ability

- Ability to follow a brief while also contributing thoughtful ideas

- Strong organization, file hygiene, and version control

- Ability to deliver finished work at a consistently high standard



Important constraints

- The first 3 seconds are generally off-limits in terms of changing the underlying footage

- Effects, polish, and editing improvements can be added, but the core opening footage usually stays

- These are hypothesis-driven variations, not random creative remixes

- Revisions are part of the process and should not be an issue

- Deliverables must be high quality, with Meta-optimized resolutions and exports



Ideal profile

You’re likely a strong fit if you:

- have edited for DTC brands or performance agencies

- understand retention, payoff, proof, pacing, and direct-response structure

- know how to make ads feel fresher without changing the core concept too much

- can collaborate with founders / marketers and improve execution quality

- understand that every edit should serve performance, not just aesthetics



Nice to have

- Experience with supplement, wellness, health, or consumer product brands

- Ability to work in Premiere Pro and After Effects

- Ability to source or create tasteful supporting motion / visual enhancement where needed

- Familiarity with version testing workflows



Working setup

- Freelance to start

- Potential for regular ongoing work / retainer if the fit is strong

- Work will be assigned on a concept-by-concept basis around winning ads we want to scale or refresh



To apply

Please send:

- a short introduction

- relevant examples of performance / direct-response ad edits

- examples where you created variations of an existing winning concept

- the software you use

- your typical turnaround times

- your rate structure

- whether you are open to a paid trial task



When applying, include the phrase: “controlled variation beats random editing” so we know you read the full brief.

title: GRADUATE/JUNIOR TECHNICAL INTERIOR DESIGNER
description:
Company Description

Arches Design Studio specialises in assisting Interior Design companies with the design development and detailed documentation of interior projects. We support projects across all stages, including Concept Design, Design Development, Pricing & Tender Documentation, Construction Documentation, and the coordination of finish, FF&E, lighting, and furniture schedules.



We work closely with our clients to deliver documentation packages that are highly detailed, technically resolved, and aligned with each studio’s standards.



Role Description:

This is a casual, temporary remote role for a Graduate / Junior Technical Interior Designer.

The role focuses on supporting the design, development and documentation of interior projects. You will be working closely with the team to produce and develop drawing packages and assist with ongoing project delivery.



Day-to-day tasks include:

 -Assisting with construction drawing sets and documentation packages 

 -Supporting the design team with Revit modelling and drawing development 

 -Setting up Revit projects, including models, views, sheets, and documentation structures 

 -Updating and coordinating drawing packages as projects progress 

 -Reviewing finishes, materials, and furniture schedules 

 -Ensuring documentation is kept up to date and delivered on time 



Availability

This position is ideal for a student or recent graduate seeking consistent weekly hours with flexibility.

Availability is required Monday to Friday in 6–8 hour blocks, with the potential for additional hours depending on project workload (up to 40 hours per week).



About You

 -Currently studying or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design 

 -Has approximately 1–2 years of Revit experience gained through university projects, coursework, or similar 

 -Confident using Revit to set up projects from scratch, including basic modelling, creating views, sheets, and assembling drawing packages 

 -Has already produced drawing sets as part of study or assessments and is comfortable working in a documentation workflow 

 -Proactive, willing to learn, and open to feedback in a fast-paced studio environment 

 -Strong attention to detail and good communication skills 

 -Interested in developing real-world studio experience with mentorship and guidance 

 -Eager to build confidence and grow into industry-ready capability

title: Amazon Virtual Assistant
description:
Atlantic Access Amazon Virtual Assistant



We’re a fast-growing client-centric European digital sales agency, helping the most exciting start-up brands launch in Europe. We cover and manage the entire end to end process for brands from logistics, digital marketing, customer service, B2B/B2C sales and full-service Amazon Europe management.



We work mainly with crowd funded brands from around the world, that have raised millions of $ on Kickstarter and Indiegogo. This is a great opportunity for someone to learn more about the start-up life and the fun and challenges of working with high growth companies.



Key Responsibilities:



• Amazon Virtual Assistant Support

o Creating products

o Ongoing Content checks – ensuring products are live, content is correct, titles are correct, bullet points are correct etc.

o Managing all back end changes and updates are kept up to date

o Uploading and managing images

o Managing price checking against external retail stores – buy box win %.

o Opening cases to trouble shoot issues

o Tracking Leaf node changes and ensuring all updates are live.

o Downloading reports and running through custom macro sheet before uploading into bulk files

o Reading daily
s and checking for any problems on SKUs (pricing, buy box, etc)

o Creating A+ content, supporting building stores.

o Reviewing PPC data for trends

o Copying out bi-weekly PPC spend and adding to spreadsheet.



To succeed in this role, you must:



Have 2-3 years minimum experience working with Amazon as a VA

Be tech savvy and understand how to use online software and Microsoft Excel in depth.



We are looking for a candidate that should:



Have excellent copywriting and communication skills

Be interested in learning more about how industries like ecommerce and marketing work

Be creative with outstanding attention to detail

Be highly organised and self-motivated



You MUST have strong written and verbal English communication skills in order to reply to customers by
 perfectly. 



This is a full-time position, five days a week (Monday–Friday), eight hours per day. As a UK-based agency, we'd expect a strong overlap with UK working hours, though we do offer some flexibility - you're welcome to start slightly earlier and finish slightly earlier to suit your timezone. 



To Apply for the job:

1. Change the subject line to "I Want to Work for You (Insert the name of our CO-Founder (you can find his name on our website))

2. At the top of your message write 2-3 few sentences on why you would like this position, and why you are a good fit.

3. Under that, put the answers to the following questions, and include the numbers to make it easy for me to read.



1) Describe your experience managing an Amazon business. How long have you spent managing accounts in total.

2) Describe one of the top Shopify or Amazon stores you managed.

3) What made this store so successful?

4) Which part of this job are you most experienced in?

5) Do you have any other experience that will make you perfect for the job?

title: Real Estate Content Creator
description:
OZ GROUP — CONTENT CREATOR Remote | Full-Time | Reports to Head of Agent Services $6–$8/hour



ABOUT OZ GROUP

Oz Group is one of New Jersey's fastest-growing real estate teams, operating under eXp Realty. Led by Joe Oz, we've built a team of 20 agents and counting — rooted in culture, driven by performance, and serious about brand. We're not your average real estate team. We invest in our people, we show up for each other, and we've created something that agents actually want to be part of. Our content reflects that and we're looking for the right person to take it to the next level.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Content Creator is responsible for executing the full scope of content creation, video editing, social media management, podcast support, and agent marketing for Oz Group and Oz Group leadership. This is a high-output, detail-oriented role that requires a strong creative eye, brand discipline, and the ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously.

The ideal candidate brings a human, emotional, and authentic voice to every piece of content produced. This is not a role for someone who wants to post and disappear. You will be the engine behind a growing brand — and the right person will take serious pride in that.

A background in real estate content is a strong advantage — if you already speak the language of listings, agents, and market positioning, you'll hit the ground running.



TOOLS REQUIRED

Canva Pro · CapCut · Opus Clip · Riverside.fm · 
 · Follow Up Boss · Slack · Constant Contact · Google Suite · Buffer



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Content Creation & Video Production

Produce and edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts on a consistent weekly basis

Create static posts with proper tagging, collaborator credits, and geo-tags

Write captions that are human, emotional, and valuable — AI tools may be used to draft but the final voice must be yours. No AI language. No hyphens. No jargon.

All posts and captions must be submitted to your direct manager for approval prior to posting

Create weekly Power Up deck content, newsletter
s, presentation decks, PDF checklists, and other design assets as directed

Podcast Management 

Own the full podcast production process from editing to distribution across YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts

Pull and edit short-form clips from each episode and distribute across social platforms

Manage the full guest booking workflow through Follow Up Boss including outreach, follow-ups, tagging, and prep communication

Create episode thumbnails per the established format for every episode

Social Media & Engagement

Engage consistently with team and industry content across platforms

Monitor and respond to DMs and comments or escalate appropriately

Grow social connections by adding real estate contacts and engaging with professionals who interact with Oz Group content per the SOP

Agent Support & Templates

Organize and maintain all Canva templates in clearly labeled folders

Support agents with listing content, personal branding templates, and marketing materials

Monitor and respond to content request form submissions promptly and deliver within the instructed timeframe

Agent Onboarding Support

Execute all media-related onboarding tasks when triggered in Follow Up Boss

Create onboarding graphics, business cards,
 signatures, social welcome posts, and Power Up slides for every new agent

Add new agents to all Oz Group social platforms and engage per the SOP

Pipeline Tracking & Meeting Support

Prepare and maintain accurate pipeline data for weekly Power Up meetings

Track listing and transaction status updates on a weekly basis

Ensure all meeting data is ready and accurate before the Monday 8:30 AM EST deadline

Workflow & Project Management

Update project status daily using the Content Organizer

Respond to Follow Up Boss tasks within 15 minutes of being tagged

Attend Monday Power Up meetings, daily end-of-day check-ins with your manager, and Level 10 meetings at the 90-day mark

Handle ad hoc requests and updates as they arise

Standards & Brand Consistency

All content must reflect the Oz Group brand identity and elevated real estate positioning at all times

Track content performance and bring proactive ideas to improve strategy

Maintain a positive, collaborative, and adaptable attitude at all times



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS

Stable, reliable internet connection required at all times during working hours

Consistent power access is mandatory. 

Daily stand-up required every day for the first 90 days without exception

Content Creator Daily Tracker must be completed by end of each business day

All content must be free of AI language, hyphens, and jargon

All posts must be approved by your direct manager before publishing

Agent and leadership requests must be acknowledged immediately upon receipt



YOU'RE THE RIGHT PERSON IF...

You produce elevated, polished designs that look intentional — not templated

Your video edits are clean, elevated, on-brand, and hold attention from the first second

You write the way real people talk.  Your captions make people feel something, not just scroll past

You can look at a piece of content and immediately know if it's good enough to represent a brand people trust

You take ownership and don't need to be told twice. If something needs to be done, you do it

Deadlines, accuracy, and follow-through aren't things you need to be reminded about.

You can manage multiple projects simultaneously without losing quality or missing details

You bring fresh creative ideas to the table and proactively look for ways to make the brand better

You want to grow with a team, not just complete tasks and clock out



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Pay: $6–$8/hour

PTO included

A team culture that's genuinely worth showing up for — we celebrate wins, support each other, and take what we do seriously without taking ourselves too seriously



HOW TO APPLY

We don't want a resume alone. We want to see your work and hear your voice.

Please submit the following:

A portfolio of your most recent work. Include static graphics and Reels that highlight your video editing skills. Show us what you're proud of.

A short video of yourself (2–3 minutes).  Tell us why you want this role, what makes you stand out, and what genuinely excites you about content creation and Oz Group. No scripts. No filters. Just you.

Applications submitted without both a portfolio and video will not be considered. Please send to 



WHY OZ GROUP

We invest in our people, take our brand seriously, and create an environment where the right person can do the best work of their career. You'll have real creative ownership, a clear lane, and a front-row seat to building a high-performing real estate team the right way.

If you read this and felt energized, not overwhelmed, you might be exactly who we're looking for.

title: Recruitment Specialist / ATS Administrator (Lever, Greenhouse)
description:
Job Title: Full-Time Operations Lead — Self-Driven Executor & Tester (Recruitment Tech, Demos & Multi-Channel Lead Generation)





Type: Full-time, long-term. Clear growth path from executor into a senior operations and management role.



Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows.



About the role and how we work together:



I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it.



The most important quality, above everything else:



You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro
, a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for.



What you will actually be doing, day to day:



On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below.



On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow,
 Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential.



Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast.



Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm.



The kind of person who thrives here:



Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them.



Skills to have already :



Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days.



Compensation:



$500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management.



To apply, please answer all of these questions in your reply. Applications that skip them will be ignored, because the ability to follow this instruction is itself part of the test:



1.Tell me about something genuinely complex that you taught yourself, using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you become good at it, and how do you know you did?



2.Which applicant-tracking platforms have you personally worked in, and what exactly did you do inside them?



3.Have you ever researched a company and then filled out forms or joined sales calls to set up software or demo accounts? Describe the experience honestly.



4.How comfortable are you with proxies, incognito browsing, managing multiple accounts, and sourcing things like phone numbers online? Honesty matters here — a real willingness to learn is perfectly acceptable.



5.Describe a specific time when something you were working on kept failing, and you had to keep trying different approaches until it worked. What happened, and what did you do?



6.Have you ever trained or managed other people? If so, describe it briefly.



7.Are you available full-time, including long days of 10-12 hours in the early phase, across Indian afternoon and night hours?

title: Remote Sales & Demo Specialist for U.S. SaaS Company
description:
ShyftGrid is looking for a serious Remote Sales & Demo Specialist to help us grow a U.S.-based SaaS platform for property operators, multi-location businesses, workforce teams, and service companies.



This is a remote position with a guaranteed monthly base plus commission, residual income, and growth bonuses. This is a strong opportunity for someone who speaks professional English, is organized, can follow up consistently, and wants to grow with a company instead of only doing short-term tasks.



ABOUT SHYFTGRID



ShyftGrid is a software platform that helps businesses manage teams, locations, scheduling, shift activity, operations, and workforce accountability. Our pricing is based on monthly recurring revenue, so this role is focused on helping us bring in real paying customers.



This is not just a basic VA job. This role is for someone who can help create sales opportunities, communicate with business owners, book demos, support demos, follow up, and help turn interested prospects into paying monthly customers.



COMPENSATION



Starting monthly base:

$500 USD per month



The monthly base covers the regular daily work:

- Lead research

- Finding qualified businesses

- Outreach

- CRM updates

- Booking demos

- Demo support

- Follow-up

- Customer communication

- Pipeline organization



Commission:

35% of the first month collected revenue from customers you help close.



Residual commission:

5% monthly residual for 12 months while the customer stays active and paying.



Important:

There is no separate demo bonus. Demo booking and demo support are part of the monthly base pay. Commission and bonuses are based on real paying customers, not just demo activity.



MRR BONUS STRUCTURE



Bonuses are based on verified monthly recurring revenue, not just the number of demos.



$2,500 MRR active for 60 days = $250 bonus

$5,000 MRR active for 60 days = $500 bonus

$10,000 MRR active for 60 days = $1,000 bonus

$20,000 MRR active for 60 days = $2,500 bonus

$30,000 MRR active for 60 days = $5,000 bonus



Customers must be real paying businesses. Free trials, refunds, chargebacks, unpaid invoices, or fake accounts do not count.



PAY GROWTH



This position starts at $500/month.



After 60–90 days, base pay may increase based on performance and verified revenue created.



Possible pay growth:

$2,500 MRR created = eligible for $650/month base

$5,000 MRR created = eligible for $750/month base

$10,000 MRR created = eligible for $1,000/month base



Pay increases are not automatic. They are based on real results, CRM tracking, consistent communication, and paying customers.



WHO THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR



This role is ideal for someone who:



- Speaks clear professional English

- Is comfortable communicating with U.S. business owners

- Is organized and consistent

- Can work remotely with minimal supervision

- Understands lead generation and sales follow-up

- Can book and support demo calls

- Can learn software quickly

- Can use a CRM properly

- Is motivated by USD income, commissions, and growth bonuses

- Wants a long-term opportunity, not short-term task work



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will help with:



- Finding property managers, cleaning companies, security companies, restaurants, warehouses, home healthcare companies, and multi-location operators

- Researching qualified leads

- Contacting business owners and managers

- Sending approved outreach messages

- Booking demos

- Helping show the software during demos

- Following up after demos

- Tracking every lead and follow-up in the CRM

- Helping prospects understand pricing

- Helping close monthly subscriptions

- Keeping the pipeline organized



MAIN CUSTOMER TARGETS



We are mainly focused on businesses that can pay monthly and have multiple locations, teams, employees, shifts, or operational problems.



Examples:

- Property management companies

- Cleaning companies

- Security companies

- Restaurants with multiple locations

- Home healthcare companies

- Warehouses

- Staffing companies

- Service businesses with field teams

- Multi-location operators



Our Starter plan is $39/month, but the main sales focus is higher-value customers:

Multi-Location Control: $99 per location per month

Operations Pro: $149 per location per month

Enterprise: Custom pricing



The goal is not just to get many small customers. The goal is to help build monthly recurring revenue.



REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Strong English communication skills

- Reliable internet

- A quiet place for calls

- Sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or customer support experience

- Ability to work U.S. business hours or partial U.S. business hours

- Ability to use CRM tools

- Ability to follow instructions carefully

- Ability to write professional messages

- Ability to attend video calls when needed

- Ability to track all activity clearly



BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH



- SaaS sales

- Property management

- Real estate support

- Appointment setting

- Cold

- LinkedIn outreach

- CRM management

- U.S. business clients

- B2B lead generation

- Demo calls

- Customer onboarding



IMPORTANT RULES



- All leads must be tracked in the approved CRM.

- Commission is paid only after customer payment clears.

- No commission is paid on demos only.

- No commission is paid on free trials, refunds, chargebacks, or unpaid accounts.

- Residual commission continues only while the customer stays active and paying.

- Bonuses are paid only after verified MRR stays active for at least 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



Please reply with the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your sales, lead generation, appointment setting, or customer support experience.

3. Your English-speaking experience with U.S. or international clients.

4. Your internet speed.

5. Your available work hours in Philippines time and U.S. Eastern Time.

6. The CRM tools you have used before.

7. A short answer to this question:



“How would you help ShyftGrid get its first 25 paying business customers?”



8. Please include a short video introduction if possible. This helps us understand your communication style.



We are looking for someone serious, organized, and motivated by long-term growth. If you want stable monthly pay plus commission and residual upside, this could be a strong opportunity.

title: Customer Support Agent — Remote
description:
About RedwoodRx

RedwoodRx is a US-based telehealth company selling compounded prescription products direct-to-consumer in the weight loss and men's health categories. We're a small, fast-moving team building something from the ground up — and we need a dedicated support agent to be the frontline for our customers.



The Role

You'll be the first point of contact for our US-based customers across chat,
, SMS, and phone. You'll handle everything from order questions and billing issues to product inquiries and subscription management. This is a full-time remote role for someone based in the Philippines.

You'll work with a small team — initially reporting to the founder, with a GHL specialist joining to build out our support systems. As we grow, you'll help shape what great customer support looks like at RedwoodRx.



Location: Remote — Philippines

Hours: Full-time (~40 hrs/week), working during EU morning / Asia afternoon hours with overlap during 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM CET (3:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT)

Start date: As soon as possible

Contract: Independent contractor (invoice-based)



What You'll Do

-Customer Support (Day-to-Day)

-Respond to customer inquiries via chat,
, SMS, and phone

-Handle order and shipping questions — tracking, delivery status, shipping delays

-Process and manage billing inquiries — refunds, failed payments, subscription changes, cancellations

-Answer product questions using approved scripts and knowledge base articles (dosage info, usage instructions, what to expect)

-Escalate medical questions to the appropriate clinical team — you are not expected to give medical advice



Operations

-Work in GoHighLevel (GHL) as the primary support platform — managing conversations, updating contact records, tagging and routing tickets

-Use CheckoutChamp for order lookups, subscription management, and processing refunds

-Use Stripe for payment lookups and dispute handling

-Use Dosable / MDI to check patient and prescription status (non-medical, operational screens only)

-Follow and help improve SOPs — flag recurring issues, suggest process improvements



Quality & Communication

-Maintain a friendly, professional, and empathetic tone — our customers are dealing with health products and expect care

-Hit response time targets (we'll set these together as we ramp up)

-Log and categorize common issues to help us spot trends



Requirements

-1–2 years of customer support experience, ideally in a remote setting

-Strong written and spoken English — you'll be on chat,
, and phone with US customers

-Comfortable working across multiple tools simultaneously (GHL, CheckoutChamp, Stripe)

-Reliable internet connection and a quiet environment for phone calls

-Available to work during EU morning / Asia afternoon hours (overlap 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT)

-Self-motivated — you'll often be the only support agent online, so you need to manage your own queue and priorities



Nice-to-Haves

-Experience in health, wellness, telehealth, or DTC subscription support

-Familiarity with GoHighLevel

-Experience handling phone support (not just chat/email)

-Understanding of basic subscription billing concepts (recurring charges, failed payments, dunning)

-Previous experience with CheckoutChamp or Stripe



Compensation

$800–$1,200 USD/month depending on experience

Paid via Wise, twice per month (15th and 30th)

Independent contractor arrangement — you invoice us, you handle your own taxes
