title: Architect / Structural Engineer (Hybrid Role) – STEEL ONE Steel Block Construction System
description:
Architect / Structural Engineer (Hybrid Role) – STEEL ONE Steel Block Construction System



We are seeking a highly skilled Architect + Structural Engineer (or hybrid professional) for an ongoing, high-volume design role within an innovative construction system called STEEL ONE.



This is a long-term opportunity to design fully custom buildings of any size or shape using a steel block construction system.



What is a Steel Block?



A steel block is an engineered structural steel unit designed to be assembled on-site into complete building structures.



Unlike prefabricated buildings, STEEL ONE structures are:



Fully custom-designed for each client

Built directly on-site using steel block components

Configured into unique architectural forms and layouts

Structurally integrated as a complete load-bearing system



Each block functions as a building element within a larger engineered steel structure, allowing unlimited architectural flexibility while maintaining structural integrity.



Role Overview



You will act as both Architect and Structural Engineer, responsible for designing complete building systems using STEEL ONE steel blocks.



Each month, you will produce multiple custom building designs based on client specifications.



Key Responsibilities

Design fully custom residential and commercial buildings

Develop architectural layouts using STEEL ONE steel block systems

Create structural engineering solutions for each project

Translate client requirements into buildable designs

Produce CAD drawings (AutoCAD / Revit / Tekla or equivalent)

Ensure structural stability, load distribution, and code compliance

Develop efficient and practical steel block configurations

Deliverables

Architectural floor plans, elevations, and sections

Structural layout and engineering design

Steel block configuration drawings

Construction-ready CAD files

Technical design documentation packages

Ideal Candidate

Architect + Structural Engineer (or strong hybrid expertise)

Experience in steel structures or advanced construction systems

Strong knowledge of building codes and structural behavior

Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, Tekla, etc.)

Experience with residential and commercial building design

Ability to design complex, non-standard structural systems

Engagement

Ongoing monthly workload (multiple projects per month)

Remote collaboration

Long-term opportunity

Vision



STEEL ONE introduces a new construction method where buildings are custom-designed and assembled on-site using engineered steel blocks, enabling speed, strength, and unlimited architectural freedom without prefabricated limitations.



We are seeking a top-level design professional to help develop and scale this system into real-world construction applications.

title: HR Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Title: Full-Time Operations Lead — Self-Driven Executor & Tester (Recruitment Tech, Demos & Multi-Channel Lead Generation)





Type: Full-time, long-term. Clear growth path from executor into a senior operations and management role.



Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows.



About the role and how we work together:



I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it.



The most important quality, above everything else:



You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro
, a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for.



What you will actually be doing, day to day:



On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below.



On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow,
 Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential.



Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast.



Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm.



The kind of person who thrives here:



Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them.



Skills to have already :



Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days.



Compensation:



$500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management.



To apply, please answer all of these questions in your reply. Applications that skip them will be ignored, because the ability to follow this instruction is itself part of the test:



1.Tell me about something genuinely complex that you taught yourself, using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you become good at it, and how do you know you did?



2.Which applicant-tracking platforms have you personally worked in, and what exactly did you do inside them?



3.Have you ever researched a company and then filled out forms or joined sales calls to set up software or demo accounts? Describe the experience honestly.



4.How comfortable are you with proxies, incognito browsing, managing multiple accounts, and sourcing things like phone numbers online? Honesty matters here — a real willingness to learn is perfectly acceptable.



5.Describe a specific time when something you were working on kept failing, and you had to keep trying different approaches until it worked. What happened, and what did you do?



6.Have you ever trained or managed other people? If so, describe it briefly.



7.Are you available full-time, including long days of 10-12 hours in the early phase, across Indian afternoon and night hours?

title: Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet.

The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce.



Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%)

Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals.

Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections.



TMC & Platform Management: Act as the primary administrator for the corporate travel management platform (e.g., Corporate Traveller, FCM, or Serko) and handle corporate profile updates.



Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) & Expense Alignment: Support the Finance team by ensuring travel expenses are accurately categorized to assist with FBT reporting and tracking meals/entertainment allowances.



2. Procurement & Supplier Relations (Approx. 40%)

Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials.



Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification.



Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms.



Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks.



3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%)

Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed.



Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties.



Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances.



I
 Management: Assist drivers with a
 reporting processes, insurance claims documentation, and coordinating roadside assistance when required.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded.



Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur).



Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with Australian business operational requirements, including GST invoicing principles, state-based vehicle registration rules, and basic workplace safety requirements.



Communication & Negotiation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to handling internal staff requests and local vendor negotiations.



Problem-Solving: Strong situational awareness with the ability to resolve rapid shifts in logistics, such as travel disruptions or freight delays.



What We Offer

Competitive salary package.

Collaborative team environment with hybrid working flexibility.

Clear pathways for professional growth and career progression across the operations and procurement functions.



Please include a link to your resume for review.

title: Boomi Integration Specialist
description:
Cloudavize is a US-based Managed Service Provider (MSP) seeking a highly analytical and solution-driven Boomi Integration Engineer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on connecting systems, optimizing data flows, and building scalable integration solutions across diverse platforms.



As a Boomi Integration Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining integrations that power business operations. If you are passionate about APIs, middleware, and solving complex integration challenges, we want to meet you!

Technologies You’ll Work With:

title: OPERATIONS VA
description:
Are you a fast-moving, detail-oriented executor who thrives in a startup environment?



We're looking for a highly resourceful Operations VA to become the first hire in a fast-growing paid ads agency that helps US home service contractors (roofing, siding, patios, decking, hardscaping) get more jobs through paid advertising and booked appointments.



This is a "black hat" role — meaning you'll handle all the operational tasks the founder no longer has time for. If you're hungry, precise, and ready to wear multiple hats while growing with a company, keep reading.



WARNING: Applying on this platform DOES NOT confirm your application. To apply, click the application form here: 
 



## What You'll Be Doing (No Two Days Are Exactly the Same)



* Running daily health checks across 8-10 client ad accounts in GoHighLevel (GHL) — pulling cost per lead, cost per appointment, and flagging anything off-threshold on Slack

* Sending pre-built SMS outreach batches to contractor prospects on schedule

* Daily reporting: total appointments booked, show rates, and setter team performance updates posted to Slack

* Full client onboarding: setting up GHL sub-accounts,
 ad accounts, A2P registration, pipeline and calendar configuration — all following documented Loom SOPs

* Building and uploading
 ad campaigns (creatives, copy, targeting) following established templates and frameworks — campaigns are reviewed and launched by the founder

* Updating client dashboards and reporting spreadsheets before strategy calls

* Chasing clients for onboarding materials (crew photos, logos, form responses) — persistent follow-up until received

* Setting up landing pages and lead forms in GHL using standard templates

* Keeping Slack organized and making sure absolutely nothing slips through the cracks



## Requirements



* Fluent in English (both written and verbal)

* Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or strong willingness to learn fast from Loom video SOPs

* Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Drive, Slack, Loom

* Basic familiarity with Meta Ads Manager — you won't be making strategic decisions, but you need to navigate the platform, read metrics, and upload campaigns

* Able to work US timezone hours (shifted schedule from Philippines) — our clients are US-based contractors, so overlap with US business hours is non-negotiable

## What You Get



* $400-$800/month depending on experience (part-time, 15-20 hours/week)

* Direct training and mentorship from the founder

* 100% remote

* You need to be micromanaged to get things done

Position: Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst

Rate: $5/hour full time + perks and benefits



Job Description:

This role plays a critical part in detecting threats, preventing attacks, and ensuring the security posture of all clients using FOS services. The SOC Analyst works closely with technicians and clients, providing both backend analysis and direct communication when handling infections, compromised accounts, or security i
.



Roles and Responsibilities. 

Alert Triage:The SOC Analyst prioritizes alerts based on severity and potential impact, ensuring that high-priority threats are addressed immediately. 



Investigation:

The analyst examines alerts in detail to determine the scope and nature of potential threats. This involves reviewing logs, endpoint activity, network traffic, and user behavior. 



Containment & Isolation: 

If a compromise is detected, the analyst isolates affected systems to prevent lateral movement, blocks malicious IP addresses, disables compromised accounts, and applies patches or other protective measures. 



Remediation & Recovery: 

Remediation includes removing malware or unauthorized software, restoring affected systems or data from backups, and performing security refreshes on client endpoints as needed. 



I
 Response & Client Support: 

The analyst handles phishing i
, spam attacks, password issues, and other security concerns. They communicate directly with clients to resolve infections, compromised accounts, and provide guidance on security best practices. 



Documentation & Analysis: 

The SOC Analyst maintains detailed records of i
, actions taken, and evidence collected. Post-i
 analysis is conducted to identify attack vectors, understand vulnerabilities, and implement preventive measures. 



Preventive Measures & Continuous Monitoring: 

The analyst implements proactive measures based on i
 findings and continuously monitors endpoints, cloud services, and network activity for recurring threats. Security configurations and detection rules are adjusted as necessary. 



Reporting:

 response, threat detection, endpoint investigations, and security tool management Demonstrated ability to handle malware infections, phishing attempts, compromised accounts, suspicious login activity, and
-based threats Experience reviewing logs, dashboards, audit reports, and alerts across multiple security platforms Background in managing whitelisting/blacklisting,

title: Influencer & Affiliate Outreach Manager For Manifestation App (Creator Partnerships)
description:
AI-Based Responses and Applications Will Be Ignored.



About the role:



We run the affiliate program for Solis, a fast-growing AI wellness app, and we're hiring an Outreach Manager to find and bring on the content creators who promote it. The owner is a best-selling author and has sold over 500,000+ copies of his books on manifestation and spirituality.



This is a relationship-driven role, not a spam-the-DMs role. Your job is to spot the right creators, start real conversations, understand what they want, and frame an offer that works for both sides. We'd rather you close ten partners who genuinely connect with the product than blast a hundred who don't. A clean "no" is a good outcome too.



You'll own the pipeline from first message to signed deal to smooth handoff.



What you'll do:



Run creator outreach across TikTok, Instagram, X, and
 using a proven message framework (and your own voice on top of it).



Qualify creators on what actually matters: real, active audiences and genuine content skill — not vanity follower counts.



Match each creator to the right program track (a creator posting to their own audience vs. a creator producing daily original content for us) and recommend the best fit.



Present offers as a clear package (base pay + performance pay + bonuses) and walk creators through the upside.



Negotiate terms that are sustainable for us and feel great to the creator. Every concession earns something back.



Onboard new partners: confirm terms in writing, send product access, the creative brief, and brand guidelines.



Keep a clean tracker of every partner, their track, agreed terms, and start date.



Run daily check-ins and flag standout performers for upgrades / non-performers to cut.



What we're looking for:



Experience in influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, or outreach/sales (1+ years preferred).



Excellent written English and a grounded, authentic communication style.



Comfortable with negotiation: confident asking for commitments and following up.



Solid understanding of the creator economy and short-form content (what makes a hook, what real engagement looks like, how to read inflated metrics).



Highly organized and self-managing: you keep your own pipeline and tracker tidy without being chased.



Reliable and responsive, able to keep multiple conversations moving at once.



Genuine interest in or familiarity with the manifestation, self-development, mindset, or wellness space. Our best partners live in that world, and it helps if you get it.



About the product:



Solis is a hyper-personalized AI visualization and affirmation app. It builds guided sessions around each person's actual life and goals, so the experience is made for them rather than generic. The audiences that connect with it most are into manifestation, self-development, mindset, and inner work — so the creators we partner with speak to it honestly, from their own experience.



How we hire — a paid trial:



We don't hire on résumés alone. Strong candidates move into a short paid trial so we can see how you actually work, and you can see whether you enjoy the role. It runs in two stages:



Stage 1 — Sourcing, classification & setup (1–2 days). You'll sort a set of creators into the right campaign track, source a handful of fresh on-niche creators yourself, draft your outreach and follow-up templates, and show us the system you'd use to track everything.



Stage 2 — Live outreach. You'll run real outreach across TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, and
, follow up multiple times throughout each platform, handle early conversations and negotiation, and help bring a few creators to the finish line.



The trial is paid (approx. $350 total, confirmed in writing before you start) whether or not it leads to a full-time offer. Do well and the full-time role is yours.



To apply, tell us briefly:



Your relevant outreach, affiliate, or influencer-marketing experience. We want to see the creators you hired and how they performed.



2 short examples of a creator you'd reach out to for a manifestation app for both an influencer campaign (they post on their own account - aligned audience), and a UGC campaign (they post daily on a sub-account - good content creator), and why you'd pick them.



Please tell us your expected monthly rate were you to move forward full-time.



Please start your message with the word "MANIFEST" so we know you read the whole post.



We're growing fast and reply to everyone. Looking forward to meeting you.

title: UGC & Influencer Outreach VA
description:
Most "creator sourcing" jobs are just sending 300 copy-paste DMs a day. This isn't that. We're looking for someone with a real eye for people, who can spot a genuinely natural creator in seconds, and who wants to own one of the most important jobs in a fast-growing brand heading into its biggest quarter ever. If you're great at this, you'll know it by the end of this post!



ABOUT US



We are a UK eCommerce brand scaling into our biggest year yet. We sell a practical, genuinely useful product through
 and Instagram ads, and our growth runs on creator-led video, real people talking about the product on camera. We are building a strong team for a huge Q4 and need someone sharp to own one of the most important jobs in the business.



THE ROLE



Your job is to find the right people to appear in our video ads, and find them fast. Most will be US-based, and many will be older (45+): mums, wives, dads, granddads etc. This is not admin work. The creators you find directly drive how well our ads perform, so this is closer to finding the right audience than filling a list.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Search for creators who match our brief and our quality bar

- Check every creator yourself before sending them to us (we will give you a simple scorecard)

- Send friendly, personalised first-contact messages

- Keep one clean, up-to-date tracker of everyone in the pipeline

- Send a short daily update and a weekly shortlist of your best finds



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- An eye for natural content. You can tell the difference between a real, believable person and someone who sounds like they are reading an ad. This is the most important skill.

- Strong, clear written English and a friendly, professional tone

- Very organised. You can manage lots of conversations at once without dropping any

- Comfortable on Instagram, TikTok, and

- Self-driven. You hit your targets without being chased

- NEEDED: you have sourced creators or influencers before, or you have been a creator yourself!



Room to grow: if this goes well, there's potential for a bigger role down the line - managing communication with signed creators as they produce content and deliver against the brief. More responsibility, more opportunity to level up! 



WHY WORK WITH US



We are growing fast and we treat this role as important!  You will get a clear path to grow with us, real responsibility from day one. We are looking for someone who is willing to come in and support the team through the whole process and feed the whole team with really good creators. 



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



To show us you have read this post, start your reply with the word "floodlight." Applications without it will not be opened.



Then answer these five questions:



1. Have you sourced or recruited creators or influencers before? Tell us about one specific creator you found, where you found them, and why you chose them.



2. Send us links to two video creators you think are genuinely natural on camera (real, not salesy or "ad-read"), with one line each on why you picked them.



3. If we asked you to find natural creators aged 50+ (older men and women), where would you look first? Give us your top 2 or 3 places or methods.



4. How do you keep track of lots of outreach conversations at once? Tell us the tool or system you use and how you stay organised.



5. Describe a time you reached out to people cold (DMs,
s, or calls). What was your approach, and what results did you get?



We are hiring quickly, so please apply within 48 hours if you are interested.



Thanks,

Jack

Reports to

Create and add new recipes to our recipe database, following our quality standards and recipe rules.

Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows.



About the role and how we work together:



I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it.



The most important quality, above everything else:



You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro
, a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for.



What you will actually be doing, day to day:



On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below.



On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow,
 Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential.



Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast.



Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm.



The kind of person who thrives here:



Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them.



Skills to have already :



Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days.



Compensation:



$500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management.



To apply, please answer all of these questions in your reply. Applications that skip them will be ignored, because the ability to follow this instruction is itself part of the test:



1.Tell me about something genuinely complex that you taught yourself, using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you become good at it, and how do you know you did?



2.Which applicant-tracking platforms have you personally worked in, and what exactly did you do inside them?



3.Have you ever researched a company and then filled out forms or joined sales calls to set up software or demo accounts? Describe the experience honestly.



4.How comfortable are you with proxies, incognito browsing, managing multiple accounts, and sourcing things like phone numbers online? Honesty matters here — a real willingness to learn is perfectly acceptable.



5.Describe a specific time when something you were working on kept failing, and you had to keep trying different approaches until it worked. What happened, and what did you do?



6.Have you ever trained or managed other people? If so, describe it briefly.



7.Are you available full-time, including long days of 10-12 hours in the early phase, across Indian afternoon and night hours?

title: Member Operations VA, Tysons Playground (Camera Monitoring + Member Support)
description:
About Tysons Playground



We are Tysons Playground, a premium strength training facility with two locations in Virginia. Our members get access to top tier equipment (Panatta, Atlantis, Eleiko, NewTech) and a serious training environment for serious people.



We have been operating since 2012 and we are growing fast in 2026. The facility is the product. Your job is to make sure every member interaction lives up to that standard.



What This Role Is



You are the eyes on our floor and the voice in our inbox. You watch our cameras during your shift, you take care of every member
 and Gymdesk message, and you run our monthly billing follow up workflow on time, every time.



This is a behind the scenes role with high visibility into how the business runs. You will own your lane and we will give you the templates, SOPs, and tools you need to ship your day without coming back for direction.



Daily Cadence



Camera Monitoring Throughout Your Shift



Watch the facility cameras during your full 7 hour window

Greet members, answer questions, and respond through our communication tools

Flag safety issues, unauthorized access, or anything off pattern to the manager immediately

Be present and attentive (this is not a background task)

Inbox and Gymdesk Management



Reply to every Gymdesk inquiry inside the Gymdesk platform using our approved templates

Handle app troubleshooting using the app support template

Respond to general inquiries with the right template and flag anything that needs the manager

Process cancellation requests through the cancellation template, then send the manager a compiled list

Forward lost and found items to the manager with member name, last name, item description, and location

Daily Member Operations



Move new guests from the guest list into the leads list every morning

Clean the leads list daily (no duplicates, no stale entries)

Keep Gymdesk tidy and current

Monthly Workflow (Hard Deadlines)



This part is non negotiable. The dates do not move.



1st of the month: Pull the overdue members list, send the report to the manager, send individual overdue notice
s using the template

3rd of the month: Crosscheck the overdue list and send a second notice to anyone still outstanding

5th of the month: Cancel memberships for everyone still overdue and send confirmation
s

Member Engagement



Send a welcome push notification to every new member

On Day 2 of a new membership, send the info package
 (app instructions, parking map, house rules)

Send birthday push notifications and birthday
s on member birthdays

What We Need From You



2+ years of experience as a Virtual Assistant or in customer service

Excellent written AND Spoken English. You will be writing to our members every single day and your tone needs to match ours (direct, friendly, professional, never generic)

Strong attention to detail. The monthly workflow has fixed dates and our members notice when things slip.

Comfort following templates and SOPs without freelancing

Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, backup power, and a working webcam

A calm head when a member is upset (this happens, especially around billing)

Self direction. We will train you, then we expect you to run your day.

Bonus Points



Experience with Gymdesk and other softwares

Experience monitoring security cameras or working a front desk

Familiarity with push notification platforms or CRM tools

Background in fitness, hospitality, or premium customer service

Tools You Will Use



Gymdesk (member management, inbox, push notifications)


Camera monitoring software (we will train you)

Schedule



7 hours per day, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM Philippine Time, Monday through Friday. We need someone who can commit to these EXACT hours every week. Camera monitoring and inbox response time mean we need you at your desk during your shift, NO exceptions.



How to Apply



Send your CV with all of the following. Anything missing means we move on to the next applicant.



A short cover letter (3 to 5 sentences) telling us why this role fits you

Your resume

A 1 minute video introduction in English (Loom is fine) so we can hear how you communicate

Your DISC profile if you have one

Your answer to this question: “A member
s in upset that they were charged this month after they thought they had cancelled. What do you do, in order, and what tone do you use?”

What You Get



Long term, stable position with predictable hours

Performance bonuses tied to inbox response time and clean execution of the monthly workflow

A team that gives you clear priorities, real templates, and the tools to do your job well

A growing company that takes operations seriously

We want to hire within 1 week. If you are the right fit, we start training right away.
